name: parse_diagnostics

test_list.description: An error message yields code, message, primary file/line/column and child details.
The primary span is followed through expansion.span to the outer call site.
A longer-than-cap expansion chain stops at MAX_EXPANSION_DEPTH.
Warning-level messages parse as Level::Warning and are not issues.
Text and malformed lines between JSON lines are skipped, not fatal.
A line nested far beyond serde_json's recursion limit is skipped without stack overflow.
`aborting due to N previous errors` is not a diagnostic.
An error located in .cargo/registry is first_party=false but still an issue, so a broken build never reads as clean.
Identical headline plus location appear once.
render_json_report emits status, error_count and errors[] with location and details (snapshot).
No errors gives status SUCCESS and count 0.
A stream over MAX_STREAM_BYTES is RtkError::StreamTooLarge.
proptest: arbitrary text through every StreamFormat does not panic.

inputs.name: stream
inputs.description: Cargo --message-format=json output, possibly with interleaved text.

output_description: Deduplicated diagnostics; errors are issues, warnings are kept as warnings.
